interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.random_curve: a, b uniform in F_p with 4a^3 + 27b^2 != 0 mod p
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.random_point: uniform over the affine points of E(F_p), y = 0 allowed (the statement does not exclude 2-torsion points); r points with distinct x
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.lift: symmetric representative in [-(p-1)/2, (p-1)/2] for both coordinates
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.fit: r = 2: unique y^2 = x^3 + A x + B through the two lifts; r = 3: unique y^2 = x^3 + a2 x^2 + a4 x + a6 through the three lifts; rational coefficients, no clearing of denominators
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.singular_fit: counted as excluded if the discriminant of the fitted curve is 0 mod p (or p divides its denominator) or is 0 over Q; with distinct x mod p the fit reduces mod p to the sampled nonsingular curve, so the expected exclusion count is 0
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.dependence: any nonzero m in [-6, 6]^r with sum m_i P~_i = O over Q, including single-coefficient (torsion) relations
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.planted_control: constructions A (r = 2 fit through two lifts, then P~_2 := [2] P~_1), B (curve y^2 = x^3 + sym(a) x + B through P~_1 alone), C (r = 3 fit, then (P~_1, [2] P~_1, P~_3)); P~_1 drawn with y != 0 so [2] P~_1 != O; detection = the planted vector (2, -1) or (2, -1, 0) is among the relations found
interpretation_choices_where_the_stateme.naive_height: log max(|num x|, |den x|) of the lifted point; reported as mean over the trial's points divided by log p

blind_predictions_for_phase_2.controls: every planted control detected; with no other relation unless an independent point is torsion
blind_predictions_for_phase_2.ptm_1: no relation within bound 6 (nor 12) for the 389a1 generators in any model
blind_predictions_for_phase_2.accidental_relations: if the producer's sampler admits y = 0 points, expect about sum_p 100 * (2 + 3) / p = 9.8 trials per seed with a 2-torsion relation, concentrated at p = 101 (about 5) and p = 211 (about 2.4); if it excludes y = 0, expect 0 accidental relations at every prime in 1600 trials (blind sample: 0/1592)
blind_predictions_for_phase_2.height_ratio: mean naive height / log p rises from about 0.65 at p = 101 to about 0.82 at p = 12809 (pooled about 0.75)
